# Feature: dotnet adapter spike

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-15 — issue #47 -->

## Intent
A small console `.csproj` fixture is detected. Doctor checks the `dotnet` SDK and blocks the run (exit 3) with checked paths when it is missing. The collector emits schema-valid samples or marks `dotnet.counters` unsupported — never NaN means.

## Preconditions
- Adapter SDK (#32)
- Generic unknown mode (#34)
- Collector hub

## Happy Path
- [x] `.csproj` / `.sln` fixture is detected with evidence
- [x] Doctor checks the dotnet SDK; missing SDK blocks run with path/version
- [x] Collector emits schema-valid samples or capability unsupported — never NaN means
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [x] Unity trees (`ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt`) are not classified as this adapter
- [x] WPF/WinUI is documented as Windows-only and unsupported
- [x] Detect is read-only
- [x] Godot C# (`project.godot` + `.csproj`) stays Godot; standalone `.csproj` is .NET

## Regression
- [x] Godot, Tauri, and web-threejs detect unchanged
- [x] Out: Unity, full Roslyn graph, WPF UI driver
- [x] `git diff packages/core` empty

## Assumptions
- Kind `dotnet` is adapter-owned; core `CandidateKind` is unchanged
- Live EventPipe is not required in CI; a fixture snapshot or unsupported is honest
- UI copy is English

## Security Coverage
- Detect is read-only
- No EventPipe dump with secrets (NFR-006); snapshot is a counters file, not a dump
- B-04: SDK locate uses path join + stat, not shell strings
- F-03: no tokens in localStorage
- Out of scope: F-01, B-01
- Secure-by-Default: PASS (no Critical/Important violations)

## Implementation Notes
- New `@potato-boost/adapter-dotnet` detects `.csproj` / `.sln` with evidence.
- Doctor `dotnet-sdk` is required; missing lists checked paths and blocks (exit 3). A fixture snapshot does not make the SDK optional.
- Collector reads `potato.dotnet-counters.json` or marks `dotnet.counters` unsupported (not required). NaN/Infinity rejected.
- `dotnet-wpf` is unsupported and not required (Windows-only, not in this spike).
- Godot detect treats `.csproj` as Godot C# only when `project.godot` exists.
- CLI/local-api merge the candidate without changing core schemas.
- Dashboard `kindLabel("dotnet")` is `.NET`.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: detect csproj/sln → doctor locates dotnet SDK → collector snapshot or unsupported.
- N-actors: one repo → one dotnet candidate; Godot no longer claims a standalone csproj.
- Invalid: missing SDK blocks; missing/invalid snapshot is unsupported/incomplete, never NaN means or invented zeros.
- Two consumers: CLI detect/doctor/run and local-api detect/doctor share the adapter.
